## Type of change

- [ ] Feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Fix (`fix`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Tests (`test`)
- [ ] CI (`ci`)
- [ ] Build or dependencies (`build`)
- [ ] Housekeeping (`chore`)

## What changed

## Why

<!-- The problem this solves, or the part of the design it delivers. -->

## Security and privacy considerations

<!-- Threat addressed, control added, what the control does not cover, and any personal data
     touched. Write "none" only if the change touches no trust boundary and no personal data. -->

## Risk and rollback

<!-- What could break, and how to undo it (for example: revert the merge commit). -->

## How it was verified

<!-- Commands run, browser checks, keyboard and reduced-motion checks for UI changes. -->

- [ ] Lint, type check, unit tests and build pass, once they exist
- [ ] No secret, `.env` file or build artifact in the diff
- [ ] `docs/PROJECT-STATE.md` and `docs/learning-log.md` match reality
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `Unreleased`, if the change is user-visible
- [ ] Any new dependency is on the approved list, or was approved by the owner
- [ ] One concern only
